Description

At 45 years of age, the above patient made the decision to pursue Breast Augmentation in Kalispell at Mountain West Plastic Surgery. Upon initial consultation, the patient expressed a desire to enhance her figure, boost her body confidence, and achieve a more balanced silhouette. Imaging revealed her initial cup size to be a B, with an overall healthy weight proportionate to her 67-inch height.Michael Hromadka, M.D., a certified member of the American Board of Plastic Surgery, performed the elective breast augmentation procedure. He employed expert surgical techniques to place 415 cc implants in both the left and right breasts, catering to the patient's vision of her desired aesthetics. Dr. Hromadka's emphasis on achieving natural-looking results ensured the operation was a success. The patient's recovery was fairly smooth and the desired results became more evident with every passing month.Twelve months post operation, the patient demonstrates a significant positive transformation which is visible in the before and after photos. The augmentation has achieved the desired enhancement and the patient expressed satisfaction with her new body contour, along with an improved sense of self-confidence. This successful procedure stands as a validation for those considering Breast Augmentation in Kalispell and serves as a testament to Dr. Hromadka's proficiency in the field. His dedication to providing aesthetic consultations and cosmetic surgeries, rooted in expertise and personalized care at his Kalispell-based practice, continually enables patients to achieve their individual body confidence goals.
